args.command:
cat > build.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

# enol form of ligand: HO-C(CF3)=CH-pyridin-2-yl
lig_smiles = 'FC(F)(F)C(O)=Cc1ccccn1'

def make_lig():
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(lig_smiles)
    rw = Chem.RWMol(m)
    oidx = [a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='O'][0]
    rw.GetAtomWithIdx(oidx).SetNoImplicit(True)
    rw.GetAtomWithIdx(oidx).SetNumExplicitHs(0)
    return rw.GetMol()

# record O and N indices in ligand
lig = make_lig()
o_idx_l = [a.GetIdx() for a in lig.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='O'][0]
n_idx_l = [a.GetIdx() for a in lig.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='N'][0]
print('lig atoms', lig.GetNumAtoms(), 'O', o_idx_l, 'N', n_idx_l)

rw = Chem.RWMol()
# add 4 ligands
lig_atom_maps = []
for i in range(4):
    mapping = {}
    for a in lig.GetAtoms():
        newidx = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(a.GetSymbol()))
        mapping[a.GetIdx()] = newidx
    for b in lig.GetBonds():
        rw.AddBond(mapping[b.GetBeginAtomIdx()], mapping[b.GetEndAtomIdx()], b.GetBondType())
    lig_atom_maps.append(mapping)

ge1 = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Ge'))
ge2 = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Ge'))
au  = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Au'))
cl  = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Cl'))

# ligands 0,1 -> ge1 ; ligands 2,3 -> ge2
for li, ge in [(0,ge1),(1,ge1),(2,ge2),(3,ge2)]:
    m = lig_atom_maps[li]
    rw.AddBond(m[o_idx_l], ge, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
    rw.AddBond(m[n_idx_l], ge, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(ge1, au, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(ge2, au, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
rw.AddBond(au, cl, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)

mol = rw.GetMol()
Chem.FastFindRings(mol)
mol = Chem.AddHs(mol)
print('atoms with H:', mol.GetNumAtoms())
cids = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, randomSeed=42, useRandomCoords=True, maxAttempts=50)
print('embed', cids)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=2000)
Chem.MolToMolFile(mol, 'initial.mol')
# write xyz
conf = mol.GetConformer()
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write('%d\ninitial guess\n' % mol.GetNumAtoms())
    for i in range(mol.GetNumAtoms()):
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write('%-3s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f\n' % (mol.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(), p.x, p.y, p.z))
print('done')
EOF
